title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: OCR scanning of images for risk scoring (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing is supported by the roadmap and Microsoft documentation. It correctly distinguishes the planned government-cloud release from the documented preview, reports the GCC billing limitation, and gives documented configuration paths and transaction pricing.

Microsoft plans OCR support for risky activity involving images in SharePoint, Teams messages and endpoints.
claims.quote: Insider Risk Management will support the scanning technique of Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to detect potentially risky activities that may lead to data security incidents related to images in SharePoint, Teams messages, and endpoints.

claims.claim: Insider Risk Management correlates activity signals to identify possible theft, leaks and security violations.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations.

claims.claim: Insider Risk Management pseudonymises users by default.
claims.quote: Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Insider Risk Management applies role-based access controls.
claims.quote: role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.

claims.quote: After configuring OCR settings (preview), your existing insider risk policies apply to both images and documents.

claims.quote: For the OCR preview, Insider Risk Management supports scanning in the following locations: Windows endpoint devices, SharePoint Online, and Teams.

claims.claim: Exchange Online and OneDrive are not supported for the Insider Risk Management OCR preview.
claims.quote: Exchange Online and OneDrive aren't supported for the preview.

claims.claim: OCR lets existing sensitive information types and trainable classifiers detect characters inside images.
claims.quote: When you enable OCR, all sensitive information types and trainable classifiers can detect characters that are in images.

claims.claim: The document processing setup page says linking an Azure subscription to pay-as-you-go automatically enables OCR for all SharePoint sites.
claims.quote: After an Azure subscription is linked to pay-as-you-go, OCR will be automatically set up and enabled for all SharePoint sites.

claims.claim: Tenant OCR already configured for DLP also supplies image processing to existing insider risk policies in their supported locations without separate IRM OCR configuration.
claims.quote: Configure OCR at the tenant level, so once OCR is configured, it's available to the entire Microsoft Purview stack.
